{{Attr|Tank}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Korblox Undead''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Classic Event]]. It hads a very high amount of health, though it was slower than every enemy that appeared before it. Additionally, it was also immune to being set on fire by towers like the [[Pyromancer]]. ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Undead''' had blue skin. It did not have a head or a torso, exposing its skeleton. It wore a grey chestplate, shoulder-pads, arm-pads, knee-pads, shoes and pants, and it also had a blue cape. Its skull had blue flames coming out of it. ==Strategy== *The [[Militant]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] can be quite effective against the '''Korblox Undead'''. *Later on during the game, high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Pursuit]] can clear out these quite easily. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxUndeadWalk.gif|Walking animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) }} ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Korblox Undead''' added. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Korblox Undead''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Korblox Undead''' re-added. *'''12 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0]] **'''Korblox Undead''' removed. {{ClassicWinter|[[Korblox Seeker (The Classic)|Korblox Seeker]] & [[Korblox Guard (The Classic)|Korblox Guard]]|Wave 1|Korblox Undead|Wave 2|[[Korblox Soul (The Classic)|Korblox Soul]]|Wave 3}} {{ClassicIslandChaos|[[Korblox Guard (The Classic)|Korblox Guard]] & [[Korblox Seeker (The Classic)|Korblox Seeker]]|Wave 1|Korblox Undead|Wave 2|[[Korblox Warrior (The Classic)|Korblox Warrior]]|Wave 4}} {{ClassicCastle|[[Korblox Guard (The Classic)|Korblox Guard]]|Wave 2|Korblox Undead & [[Normal Boss]]|Wave 3|[[Korblox Seeker (The Classic)|Korblox Seeker]] & [[Breaker2]]|Wave 4}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Korblox Undead}}
